description: Compares clicks, impressions and CTR of two equal-length, non-overlapping periods whose totals you provide, for example from Google Search Console. It splits the click change into an impressions component and a CTR component and checks the dates against known Search Console reporting issues, withholding impression-based figures for affected dates. Use it when you have totals for two periods; for a single what-if, project_clicks_at_ctr and impressions_needed_for_clicks fit better. The result does not establish why CTR changed; the warning NO_AI_CAUSATION is always included.

current.description: Totals of the later period, for example from the Search Console Performance report.

clicks.description: Total clicks in the later period, a whole number.

end.description: Last day of the later period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

impressions.description: Total impressions in the later period, a whole number, at least the clicks.

start.description: First day of the later period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

prior.description: Totals of the earlier period, for example from the Search Console Performance report.

clicks.description: Total clicks in the earlier period, a whole number.

end.description: Last day of the earlier period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

impressions.description: Total impressions in the earlier period, a whole number, at least the clicks.

start.description: First day of the earlier period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

source.description: Where the numbers come from: gsc_ui_export (Search Console Performance report or its export), bulk_export (BigQuery bulk export), api (Search Console API) or other. Some reporting issues apply to one source only.

name: compare_ctr_periods

evidence.description: observed, calculated (exact arithmetic), modelled (depends on an assumed CTR) or not_established.

nullReason.description: Why value is null; null when there is a value.

unit.description: ctr_fraction (0.045 = 4.5%), percentage_points, percent, clicks or impressions.

value.description: The unrounded value, or null when it is undefined or withheld.
